name: picture-watchdog
summary: When the selected input restarts its detection 3 times without ever accepting a signal (black screen without "No signal"), repeat the input selection as the vendor does at menu close; if that does not help, one hot-plug pulse (stock wake behaviour) and the selection again; RAM 0x2024D1 restarts, 0x2024D2 recoveries
status: v1 fired falsely after a normal attach (2026-10-08, harmless); v2 untested

edits.asm: pw_rst / pw_acc / pw_task (image head zero area 0x201800); state RAM 0x2024D0-D4
sub_23B068 restart: jal sub_23E64A(port, 1) -> jal pw_rst
sub_23B068 no-signal decision: jal sub_23E64A(port, 2) -> jal pw_ns
sub_23B068 signal accepted: jal sub_23E64A(port, 3) -> jal pw_acc
main loop: jal sub_260ACF -> jal pw_task
